## Abstract

We will look at the brand new MATLAB Grader functionality in Moodle, featuring examples, tips and tricks, and a few drawbacks. Participants are encouraged to activate their MathWorks account first [https://www.mathworks.com/](https://www.mathworks.com/), use your Unity credentials) and bring a laptop to experiment with. If you would like to be a student in a Moodle Project space to try some Grader problems during the session, please contact me [bmaults@ncsu.edu](mailto:bmaults@ncsu.edu) so I can add you to the roster.
